title: Virgin Islands Coastal Zone Management Act of 1978 (Act No. 4248), 12 V.I.C. ch.21
citation: 12 V.I.C. ch.21 (s.901 et seq.), Act No. 4248 of Oct. 31, 1978
evidence: DPNR copy of the chapter, history note: 'Effective date. Act Oct. 31, 1978, No. 4248, § 24, Sess. L. 1978, p. 317, provided: ‘The effective date of this Act [that added this chapter] shall be February 1, 1979.‘' Opened https://dpnr.vi.gov/coastal-zone-management/coastal-zone-management-rules-regs/ on 2026-11-10.
notes: Narrower than a climate or disclosure law: a coastal land-use and permit statute (s.903 findings and goals, s.904 Coastal Zone Management Commission) with no climate, emissions or disclosure wording found. The DPNR page republishes the chapter from the annotated Code, current through Act 8310 of the 33rd Legislature (code changes through July 21, 2020), and the DPNR host calls its Code copies unofficial; the Code's Lieutenant Governor copyright notice and the missing reuse terms make the row permission requested. Link only. English is the only language seen; no translation exists or is needed.
